actions.name: add_line_item_to_invoice
actions.title: Add line item to invoice
actions.description: Add line item to invoice in FreshBooks

input.name: name
input.label: Item/task
input.hint: Item for item entries or Task for time entries

input.name: quantity
input.label: Quantity
input.hint: Defaults to 0

input.name: unit_cost
input.label: Unit cost
input.hint: Defaults to 0

input.name: type
input.label: Type
input.hint: Defaults to Item

input.name: username
input.label: Username
input.hint: Defaults to first name + last name

input.name: password
input.label: Password
input.hint: Defaults to random password

input.name: client_id
input.label: Client ID
input.hint: Unique ID identifier

input.name: project_id
input.label: Project ID
input.hint: Unique ID identifier

input.name: date
input.label: Date
input.hint: Defaults to current date if left empty

input.name: amount
input.label: Amount
input.hint: Amount must be inclusive of tax

input.name: tax1_percent
input.label: Tax 1 percent
input.hint: Percentage tax that should be paid

input.name: tax1_amount
input.label: Tax 1 amount
input.hint: Actual tax paid in expense. Amount can be less than calculated amount.

input.name: tax2_percent
input.label: Tax 2 percent
input.hint: Percentage tax that should be paid

input.name: tax2_amount
input.label: Tax 2 amount
input.hint: Actual tax paid in expense. Amount can be less than calculated amount.

input.name: client_id
input.label: Client ID
input.hint: Unique ID identifier

input.name: status
input.label: Status
input.hint: By default, the status is draft

input.name: number
input.label: Invoice number
input.hint: Will increment from the last invoice number if not specified

input.name: date
input.label: Date
input.hint: If not supplied, default's to today's date

input.name: currency_code
input.label: Currency code
input.hint: Defaults to your base currency

actions.name: lookup_staff_member
actions.title: Search staff members
actions.description: Search for staff member in FreshBooks

input.name: name
input.label: Name
input.hint: Get details of staff member corresponding to this name

input.name: invoice_id
input.label: Invoice ID
input.hint: Payment will be recorded as invoice payment if invoice ID is entered

input.name: client_id
input.label: Client ID
input.hint: Payment will be recorded as client credit if client ID is entered

input.name: date
input.label: Date
input.hint: Defaults to today's date if not entered

input.name: currency_code
input.label: Currency code
input.hint: Will only be applied when creating a credit. Regular payments default to currency of invoice

input.name: type
input.label: Type
input.hint: By default, the status is check
